author: Mellika363

title: Best habit tracking app
body: This app has gotta be the best free habit tracking app ever and I’ve tried a lot of them. If you don’t want to pay for subscription, this app will still be functional and will NOT limit the amount of habits you can add (I’ve been looking for this 😭) and it also has a nice little overview. I love this app!!!
